newsitem.title: USA: Investor ups Manor Care stake to 8.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Investor ups Manor Care stake to 8.1 pct.

text.p: New York investor Ronald Baron Wednesday said he raised his stake in Manor Care Inc to 8.1 percent or 5.03 million common shares from 6.9 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Baron said he and his affiliates bought 327,200 additional shares of the company between Aug. 2 and Sept. 30 at prices ranging from $33.4975 to $38.12 a share.

Baron is president of Baron Capital Management Inc, BAMCO Inc and Baron Capital Inc. The group also includes Baron Asset Fund and Baron Growth & Income Fund which are advised by Bamco, a registered investment adviser.
